set.body:
Scope

Strengthen the existing typed contrast compiler and fit inference path. Preserve name-keyed T/F constructors as compatibility adapters, but make structural compilation authoritative.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A compiled hypothesis carries its ContrastId, semantic description, DesignFingerprint, selected structural ColumnIds, dense weight vector/matrix, source, and test rank.
- [ ] Compilation resolves factor/cell/modulator/basis selectors through structural origins, never through rendered-name parsing.
- [ ] The compiler reports unknown factors/levels/basis elements, empty selections, duplicate identities, invalid weights, and non-estimable functions as typed errors.
- [ ] Estimability evidence records the relevant design rank/row-space decision and accompanies the lowered hypothesis.
- [ ] Applying a compiled hypothesis to a different fingerprint fails before numerical evaluation, even if labels and dimensions happen to match.
- [ ] Consistent column reordering preserves hypothesis estimates/statistics after structural alignment.
- [ ] Rank-deficient tests compare estimable functions and fitted geometry rather than arbitrary generalized-inverse coefficients.
- [ ] F tests record and validate numerator rank instead of assuming the number of supplied rows.
- [ ] Existing TContrast/FContrast APIs either delegate through the structural path or are clearly marked compatibility-only.
- [ ] Unit and scenario tests pass on JVM and Scala.js, including deliberate wrong-design and non-estimable cases.
set.title: P1.3: bind compiled hypotheses to structural columns and estimability evidence
